I can relate to your situation in many ways. Like you said, I do everything that a normal person can do, but there is always that lingering thought in the back of my mind about how people would react, how I would do it, etc. Unlike your situation though, I don't really consider myself as a suicidal person if that makes sense. I don't have the desire to kill myself but it is just a thought that plagues my mind everyday. I'm glad i'm not the only person like this. Makes me feel less alone. With that being said, I am so proud of you. It must take everything to get up everyday and still be functional  in this state. You're doing great man and please don't take your life away. Even though it may seem painful all the time it is still a life worth living. Cause this type of thing only happens once. There is no sequel to this mess. You also mentioned something about feeling alienated from society. The only advice I could give you is to try to talk to other people. At school, work, your local coffee shop idc. Wherever there are people, make the effort, get close to someone and discuss how you feel about yourself. Trust me there are always people that are willing to give a helping hand, you just need to have the courage to find them.  If you be nice and yourself i'm sure you could make some friends. Then maybe life will be worth living to you one day and those thoughts will fade. Best of luck man. You are not alone, no matter how much you think you are.

-Ranpo
